auth.identifierHelp: Team member accounts sign in with a phone number.
auth.passwordShort: The password must have at least {{min}} characters.

login.title: Sign in
login.notVerified: Your email address is not verified. We have sent you a new verification link; open it, then sign in.
login.haveCode: Did your admin give you a code?
login.signedInSub: This browser is signed in with this account.
login.waitCountdown: Too many attempts. You can try again in:
login.tooManyIn: Too many attempts. Try again in about {{minutes}} minutes.

register.title: Create your account
register.name: Full name
register.terms: By creating an account, you accept the following:
register.closed: New registrations are closed at the moment. Ask a company admin for an invitation or a code.
register.inviteOnly: Accounts are invitation-only right now. Write to us for an invitation:
register.currencyNote: The company currency will be {{currency}}. You can change it on the Company screen in Hub.
register.clipped: At most {{max}} characters; anything longer is left out. Please check the text.

join.signedInSub: This browser is signed in with this account. If the code is for someone else, sign out first.
join.logoutAndJoin: Sign out and join with the code
join.title: Join with a code
join.sub: Enter the code from your admin and your phone number.
join.codeHelp: 8 characters. Upper or lower case both work.
join.existingSub: This phone number already has an account. Enter your current password to confirm.
join.newSub: Check your name and set a password.
join.currentPasswordHelp: The code does not change your password.
join.resetSub: Your admin at {{org}} created a password code.
join.linkSub: This number is linked to the account you are signed in to. No new account is created.
join.linkPasswordHelp: The password of the account you are signed in to.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.invalidBody: The link may have expired or been revoked. Ask your admin for a new one.
invite.loginFirst: This email already has an account. Sign in first to accept the invitation.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.sub: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this email, we sent a link. Check your inbox.
forgot.noEmail: No email address? Ask your company admin for a new code.
forgot.mailOff: Email sending is off. If you sign in with a phone number, your company admin can create a new code. Otherwise contact whoever runs this installation.
forgot.subMailOff: A password reset link cannot be sent on this installation.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Your password has changed. You can sign in with it now.

verify.passwordText: To make sure it was you who created this account, enter the password you chose when signing up.
verify.passwordForgot: I didn't create this account or don't know the password
verify.title: Email verification
verify.changed: Your new email address has been saved.
verify.failed: The link is not valid or has expired.

verifySent.title: Verify your email
verifySent.body: We sent a verification link to this address. Your account becomes active when you open it, then sign in.
verifySent.resent: A new link has been sent. If it does not arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

auth.weakPassword: This password is too common. Choose a different one.
